title: GateDecisionChallengeView
description: Source of truth: DHT (mishpat DNA, GateDecisionChallenge entry, Notarized, Category A). A formal challenge filed against a GateDecisionAttestation. This record is a read-optimised projection populated by the MishpatSignal::GateDecisionChallengeCreated post-commit signal. If this projection and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

challengeId.description: CID of this challenge (self-addressing, globally unique)

challengedDecisionCid.description: CID of the GateDecisionAttestation being challenged

grounds.description: Grounds on which the challenge is filed

evidenceRefs.description: Content-addressed evidence refs (comma-separated CIDs; empty string if none)

filedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the challenge was filed

reach.description: Reach level of the challenged decision's impact

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash (base64) of the upstream DHT entry — client can use this to verify provenance

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this projection row was inserted
